new.s: Which programme was launched in December 2014 for full immunisation of children and pregnant women under the Universal Immunisation Programme?
new.x: Mission Indradhanush (Dec 2014) is a catch-up drive under the Universal Immunisation Programme for full immunisation of children and pregnant women.
new.angle: U0439 #1 Health programme -> objective (Mission Indradhanush)

new.s: In which year did the Pulse Polio programme begin in India?
new.x: Pulse Polio began in 1995; WHO certified India polio-free in 2014.
new.angle: U0439 #1 Health programme -> launch year (Pulse Polio)

new.s: What was the earlier name of Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY?
new.x: PM-JAY was first called the National Health Protection Scheme; it subsumed RSBY (2008).
new.angle: U0439 notes gap: PM-JAY earlier name

new.s:
Consider the following statements about Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY:
1. It is the world's largest health assurance scheme fully financed by the government.
2. It gives a cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: PM-JAY is the world's largest (not second-largest) government-funded health assurance scheme, with ₹5 lakh cover per family per year.
new.angle: U0439 PYQ yc8dd91e1873 PM-JAY features -> world's largest

new.s: Which of the following is a social security programme?
o: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
new.x: PMJJBY gives life cover to the poor and is a social security (insurance) scheme; the others are infrastructure or industry programmes.
new.angle: U0439 PYQ yd53e2859d1a/yb463d41c3de Social protection programme -> identify

new.s: Which of the following is a social assistance programme rather than a social insurance programme?
new.x: NSAP is non-contributory and tax-funded, so it is social assistance; EPF, APY and ESI are contributory social insurance.
new.angle: U0439 PYQ yd53e2859d1a Social protection programme -> type

new.s: Which of the following is NOT a parameter of the National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF)?
new.x: NIRF uses Teaching-Learning, Research and Professional Practice, Graduation Outcomes, Outreach-Inclusivity and Perception; foreign faculty ratio is not a parameter.
new.angle: U0439 PYQ y7e9a43361f3 NIRF parameters
